intent_contract.text: 시각 의미 데이터화 후보팩에 반영해줘. 그 다음 독립된 서브에이전트 5개에서 각각 서로 다른 컨셉으로 반영한 키워드가 이미지에 실제로 반영되는지까지 테스트할 수 있는 랜덤한 복잡한 컨셉을 정하여 테스트케이스를 마련하고 첨부한 이미지를 활용하여 프롬프트 작성하고 이미지 생성하도록 하여 잘 반영되었는지 테스트해줘.

Create one independently invented complex photographic test case in a surreal astronomical natural-history observatory, using the attachment only as facial-appearance guidance. The agent-selected test variation interprets the target geometry as a propped-elbow recline with visibly borne load, one continuous C-shaped body arc, and body-bounded negative space enclosed by the bent elbow and torso; these are experiment interpretations, not requester definitions.

Wide full-body editorial photograph inside a cliffside astronomical natural-history observatory at blue hour. One clearly adult East Asian woman naturalist with facial appearance inspired by the attached reference wears an opaque high-neck cobalt field suit of dense matte canvas, long sleeves, full-length trousers, gloves, and boots. She reclines sideways across a crescent basalt specimen bench while recording a living glass nautilus whose shell projects a rotating constellation into a shallow tide pool. Her left elbow is planted on a raised padded ledge, forearm upright and palm at her temple; compressed sleeve fabric and a settled shoulder visibly show the elbow carrying her upper-body weight. From head through ribcage, waist, bent knees, and boots, her body follows one continuous C-shaped arc. A crisp opening of luminous water is enclosed by her bent elbow, inner forearm, torso, and waist. Show both boots, every limb, the full bench, and the elbow contact unobstructed, amid telescope mechanisms, pinned kelp specimens, salt haze, and reflected starlight.
